home.title: Motion that brings Krizaka screens to life.
home.lead: Try each animation live, change its settings, copy its code. What proves itself here ships in Krizaka UI.
home.demosTitle: Six experiments, each at its own address.
home.demosLead: Live previews: they play on screen and rest under reduced motion.
home.shippedEyebrow: From the lab to Krizaka UI
home.shippedLead: Rebuilt in SVG and CSS for every Krizaka site: @krizaka/ui/engine-flow. No canvas, no animation frame, paused off screen.
home.experimental: Experimental — canvas, for the lab only

demo.usageLead: The lab's views are React components over a canvas renderer.
demo.statusLab: A lab experiment: a canvas paused off screen and still under reduced motion. Not for the Krizaka sites, which use Krizaka UI.

controls.hint: Point at a product to see what it runs on the engine.
controls.flowLabel: An engine and the products it powers

uses.yomizaka: Document checks, each a traced run.

controls.canvasLead: The lab's first version: a canvas renderer with telemetry, kept for comparison.

specs.rules: The rules a lab view follows
items: One conductor: the views listen to @krizaka/ui's MotionObserver (data-offscreen, data-motion) — they never start their own observer of the page.
Off screen, paused; while the page settles, held; under reduced motion, one still frame.
Every colour from the tokens; every word a prop; the marks from @krizaka/ui, never redrawn.
A text version beside every drawing; every control reachable by keyboard.
What a Krizaka site needs moves into Krizaka UI as SVG and CSS — the canvas stays here.
specs.testsText: Springs, Bézier lengths, optics, routes and palettes are unit-tested; the shell's pages are checked at 360 to 1440 px for horizontal overflow.

orazaka.name: Engine flow
orazaka.title: One engine, the products it powers.
orazaka.lead: Requests flow in, results come back — the flow krizaka.com's home draws, with its settings.
orazaka.card: Radial, top to bottom or left to right; in, out or both.

yororis.name: Voice presence
yororis.title: A presence that rests, listens and speaks.
yororis.lead: An acoustic sphere that follows a voice's frequencies — procedural, or your microphone if you allow it.
yororis.card: At rest, listening, speaking: a sphere that follows the voice.

jarvis.name: Holographic HUD
jarvis.title: A heads-up display, drawn live.
jarvis.lead: Rings, reticles and telemetry with a gyroscope's parallax — a study of dense, legible motion.
jarvis.card: Reticles, rings and telemetry with parallax.

caustics.name: Liquid glass
caustics.title: Light bending through a liquid surface.
caustics.lead: Snell's law and chromatic dispersion over the page: touch it to send a ripple.
caustics.card: Refraction and dispersion; touch for a ripple.

lattice.name: Neural lattice
lattice.title: A lattice of neurons that fire.
lattice.lead: Membrane potentials, synapses that strengthen with use, cascades you can trigger.

kz-ui.name: Krizaka UI motion
kz-ui.title: The motion that already ships.
kz-ui.lead: The primitives of @krizaka/ui's one motion system, live: what the Krizaka sites use.

architecture.name: Specs
architecture.title: Specs and rules.
architecture.lead: How a lab view behaves, and how one becomes a Krizaka UI primitive.
architecture.card: The motion rules, the tests, the path to Krizaka UI.

journey.name: Journey
journey.title: A job, step by step.
journey.lead: Steps complete, one is in progress with its own progress, one can fail — said in words as well as shown.

overlays.name: Overlays
overlays.title: Panels that arrive.
overlays.lead: A dialog, a sheet and a drawer enter from their edge; one indicator slides under the active item of NavBar and Tabs.

people.name: People
people.title: People who arrive.
people.lead: An avatar stack that fills, a verified badge that appears, milestones that unlock one by one.

gallery.title: Real components, brought to life.
gallery.lead: Components of @krizaka/ui with their motion, and the lab's views behind them — each with its live result, the exact imports, its props and what it does under reduced motion.

groupLeads.feedback: Say that something happened — or is happening.
groupLeads.emphasis: Draw the eye to what matters, once.
groupLeads.data: Make figures and flows readable as they change.
groupLeads.ambient: Give a screen a pulse without asking for attention.

button.title: Button
button.what: The one action of a screen: quiet under the pointer, a loader announced while it works.
button.reduced: The loader is drawn still; the label changes to Saving and the button is announced as busy.

toast.title: Toast
toast.what: Confirm an action and offer to undo it, without leaving the page.
toast.reduced: Toasts appear and leave at once: no fade, no slide.

progress.title: Progress
progress.what: How far a task has gone, with a smooth fill and an announced value.
progress.reduced: The bar jumps to each value.

dialog.title: Dialog (side panel)
dialog.what: Settings or details that slide in beside the work, focus kept inside.
dialog.reduced: It appears in place, without sliding.

glow-card.title: GlowCard
glow-card.what: One featured card: a still hairline ring of the brand gradient, fuller than on a plain card and a step brighter under the pointer or the focus.
glow-card.reduced: Nothing moves in any case; the ring only brightens under the pointer or the focus.

badge.title: Badge and Chip
badge.what: A live status whose dot pulses, and choices whose selection fades from one to the next.
badge.reduced: The dot stays lit without pulsing; the selection still changes.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.what: Views of one subject, the light gliding under the chosen one.

avatar-presence.title: Avatar with a presence
avatar-presence.what: Someone speaking: the lab's voice presence glowing behind an avatar.
avatar-presence.reduced: A still sphere behind the avatar.

stat.title: Stat with NumberTicker
stat.what: A key figure that climbs once when it comes into view.

data-table.title: DataTable row
data-table.what: The row that changed, marked in a table people read.
data-table.reduced: The highlight is a plain colour change: nothing moves.

engine-flow.title: EngineFlow
engine-flow.what: One engine and the apps it serves: what travels, and which way.

lattice-card.title: Card over a living lattice
lattice-card.what: A figure card over the lab's neural lattice: activity you can feel, figures you can read.
lattice-card.reduced: A still lattice under the card.

waveform.title: Waveform
waveform.what: A voice or a sound that plays: its bars breathe while it plays.
waveform.reduced: Still bars at their real heights.

chat.title: MessageBubble and TypingIndicator
chat.what: A conversation that is alive: someone is typing.

marquee.title: Marquee
marquee.what: A band of names that slides, paused by the pointer, the focus or its button.
marquee.reduced: A still row you scroll by hand.

navbar.title: NavBar
navbar.what: The family's bar: one light gliding between the items, resting on the current page.

glass-card.title: Card over liquid glass
glass-card.what: A card floating over the lab's liquid caustics: depth for a hero, text kept readable.
glass-card.reduced: A still caustic image under the card.

studies.title: Paper, ink and pencil, with native web motion.
studies.lead: Small studies for the Cahier identity, made with the platform alone: SVG, the Web Animations API, scroll-driven animations, anchor positioning, popovers and View Transitions. Each one works, falls back and rests under reduced motion. The generic ones become @krizaka/ui/motion pieces.

ink.title: Ink writing
ink.what: A signature written by a pen stroke on ruled paper: one SVG path, drawn by its dash offset.
ink.reduced: The signature is already written; Write again changes nothing.

stamp.title: Stamp press
stamp.what: « Fait à Montréal » lands with a squash on contact and a spring settle, a linear() easing on the Web Animations API.
stamp.reduced: The stamp appears in place, without the fall or the squash.

underline.title: Pencil underline
underline.what: A hand-drawn underline that follows the reading position: scroll the page and the line is drawn as far as you have read.
underline.reduced: The line is drawn in full; the scroll no longer draws it.

marginalia.title: Marginalia
marginalia.what: A margin note anchored to the words it explains, opened as a popover that grows out of its anchor.
marginalia.reduced: The note opens and closes at once, in place.

page-turn.title: Page turn
page-turn.what: Two routes and one shared element: the page you leave folds along its spine, the next one arrives (View Transitions).
page-turn.reduced: The page changes at once, no fold.
